steps.request: Change the shared schedule configuration from seconds to milliseconds everywhere. config/schedule.json keys become `interval_ms` and `jitter_ms` (30000 and 5000). The Python worker (worker/schedule.py: next_delay) and the JavaScript poller (web/poller.js: nextDelayMs) must read the new keys and return milliseconds, and docs/schedule.md must describe the new keys and unit. The existing visible tests encode the old unit; the graders encode the new one. Do not rely on editing tests.
